text:
harper: Quick run-through: multinregion marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP) planned next Tue. We need embargo coordination across APAC & EU, hardware partner tile gating, and SI integration badges. Who's taking press, cutover, legal chase?

noah: I'll own press + media list. Draft PR in Drive (v3). Note: one partner asked for a 48h embargo delay for APAC reporters due to local event. We need to confirm asap.

sylvia: I'll do microsite swap and tile rendering. Feature flag = marketplace-multi-region. Cutover steps: verify assets in S3, flip flag, run CDN invalidation, smoke tests. Dry-run on staging scheduled 90m prior.

diego: Legal & partner signoff owner. HW partner Alpha has a paid-ads restriction (web hero ok, ads not). I'll escalate to their legal and document constraints. If they block, we swap to neutral hero.

ops-bot: Maintenance window at 6612347000. Any releases blocked during that window. Schedule cutover to finish at least 45m before.

harper: Good catch ops-bot. Proposed timing for APAC primary window: embargo lift 23:00 SGT, blog 23:20 SGT, microsite swap 23:35 SGT. EU window: embargo lift 07:00 BST next day, blog 07:15 BST. We may need two swaps or a single multinregion feature.

noah: If partner requests delay, we should stagger APAC vs EU launches. I'll draft two embargo emails and include clear UTMs (utm_source=partner_marketplace&utm_campaign=multi_region_q3).

sylvia: Technical note: set Cache-Control: no-cache on partner pages during cutover and run targeted purge for /marketplace/* after flag flip. I'll include rollback curl in runbook.

diego: Partner legal responded: Alpha granted hero use for web only, denied paid-ads. Asset pack uploaded with usage note. I'll flag this in press kit.

press-bot: Reminder: media embargo list requires press contact method (email or presswire) and a plaintext timeline.

harper: Owners: harper (launch lead), noah (press & UTMs), sylvia (microsite/cutover/runbook), diego (legal/partner coms). Action items: 1) confirm APAC delay decision (noah & diego) 2) final asset pack check (sylvia) 3) dry-run + runbook posted (sylvia) 4) UTMs + media one-pager (noah). Reply when done.

noah: Pinged partner about 48h delay; they're ok with APAC pushing on original schedule if EU is shifted. I'll prepare staggered embargo emails and media one-pager.

sylvia: Verified assets in S3, runbook PR opened (ops repo sha=zz9f). Dry-run scheduled 90m prior. CDN purge command included.

diego: Legal green for Alpha with usage constraints; noted in press kit. Chasing Beta partner for final logo.

harper: Great. Final contingency: if Beta doesn't sign by cutover we hide their tile and show "Partner details coming soon". We'll run the cutover before ops-bot window. Moving to #launch-room for live ops. :rocket:
